title: Unnamed buttons, links and fields, and nested interactive controls
expected: Every control has an accessible name; interactive elements are not nested.
actual: button-name: 16 buttons on 7 pages; link-name: 12 links on 3 pages (orders); label: 2 inputs on /products/create; select-name and image-alt on /nearby; svg-img-alt on /feed; nested-interactive: 13 notification rows; aria-prohibited-attr: 19 elements (aria-label on plain div/span: Google sign-in slot, 'Guest session' badge).
impact: Screen-reader users hear 'button' with no purpose on order management and product creation — core seller journeys.
fix: Add aria-label to icon-only buttons and image links (reuse their tooltips), associate labels with the price/stock inputs, make notification rows a single link or button, and give the aria-labelled div/span a role (e.g. role="img" or role="group") or drop the label.
